description: The authoritative member register: the one place an anonymous member id (Member-01) is mapped to a legal entity name, an admission date and an ownership percentage. Names live here and nowhere else — not in the chart of accounts, not in cost centers.

fields.description: The anonymous identifier this member is known by everywhere else on the site — in the Member accounting dimension, on journal entry lines, in reports. Unique per company.
fields.label: Member ID

fields.description: The legal name of the member: an individual, a trust, an LLC. This is the only field on the site that carries it.
fields.label: Legal Entity Name
Entity Type
fields.options:
Individual
Trust
LLC
Corporation
Partnership
Other

fields.description: When this member exited. Set by close_cap_table_entry, together with Retired.
fields.label: Withdrawal Date

fields.description: Ownership percentage as of the last change. Historical percentages live in the Member Event trail, not here.
fields.label: Ownership Percentage

fields.description: A retired member stays in the register for historical continuity — the postings they are tagged on do not disappear when they leave.
fields.label: Retired

fields.description: Optional. Only for sites whose convention gives each member a cost center as well as a dimension value. Left empty, member postings are tagged by the Member accounting dimension alone.
fields.label: Member Cost Center

fields.description: The DocType whose records are the Member accounting dimension's values, recorded when the member id was matched against one at creation. Informational.
fields.label: Member Dimension DocType

fields.description: The Employee record this member captures receipts as. Lets a receipt the member marks "I'm covering this" find their draw account.
fields.label: Employee

fields.description: The equity draw account a purchase this member personally covers is booked to (e.g. 3610 Draws – Tim), and the default credit for a company expense they paid on a personal card. Used by create_owner_draw and post_reimbursement_receipt.
fields.label: Draw Account

fields.description: Why this member exists, what documents evidence the membership, anything a successor trustee would need. Supporting paperwork goes in the attachments.
fields.label: Notes

name: Cap Table Entry
